notes.title: Episode 5.0 – Dev Log & Release Date
notes.notes:
[p align="start"]Hey everyone!
Time for the update you’ve all been waiting for – progress news and the release date for Episode 5.0!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/79f89f488627ffe7bf4ee511b1072913f33cb6f8.png"]
[p align="start"]We’re almost there: only two more scenes left to finish on the art side, and we’re rendering the final animations. Scenes are already being added and coded into the game. Next week we’ll begin translations. On top of that, there will be new achievements, bonus content, wallpapers, and a small UI upgrade. The replay system will also get better – you’ll be able to see how to unlock them and easily check what content you might have missed.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]And now, the dates you’ve been waiting for - Episode 5.0 will be available for:

Devoted+ tiers – November 5 (evening CET)

Inquisitive+ tiers + Steam & Itch – November 8 (evening CET)

Attentive tier – November 15 (evening CET)


[p align="start"]We know this update took longer than usual. It’s a normal-sized release (bigger than previous ones, around 10 scenes and 60–90 minutes of gameplay, but won't call it big). But don’t worry – a big DLC is coming just a month later, with more details in early October. And yes, we’ve got a few more surprises planned too!
[p align="start"]One more piece of news: Exploring the Big Apple – a game by SadPepper, published by us – will be available on Steam, October 17! It comes with a fresh UI, translations, sounds, and more. If you haven’t already, make sure to add it to your wishlist.
[p align="start"]

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3720820/Exploring_the_Big_Apple/"][/dynamiclink]


[p align="start"]And finally – here are some fresh renders from the update.
See you soon!

notes.title: Episode 4.2 - Change Log & Release Date
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!


This is probably the post many of you have been waiting for – what’s coming in update 4.2 and when it will be released.

First, just a reminder – this will be a smaller update. Things are still very busy in real life, and I barely have time for anything. We haven’t even had time to think about our honeymoon yet 😅

But I hope things will get calmer over time and I’ll have more time for everything. Luckily, my team is working super hard, and thanks to them, we’re still able to release updates at a good pace.

Episode 4.2 will be a bit of a “bridge” episode as we move into the core parts of the story. Episode 5.0 will be a much bigger moment – a full opening for you and Riley :)

Now, what to expect in this update:

7 new scenes

Around 1400 new renders

Lots of new animations

Nearly 17,000 words of script

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/e57d9c5436245f12dc8af9c557740cd6c4d1471b.png"]

Normally, I tell you what scenes are coming, but this time – it’s a surprise. One scene had to be cut, but we’ll include it in episode 5.0, so it’s not lost.

We’re also adding a new movie to buy on the laptop and watch on the TV. There’s a new outfit, so… maybe a stream with Elijah? There’s also a lot of content with the neighbors and at the bar – but no more spoilers ;)

And now the release dates you’ve been waiting for:

June 22 – Devoted+ tiers on Patreon

June 24 – Inquisitive+ tiers, Steam

June 30 – Attentive tier on Patreon

There’s still a lot of work left – fixing bugs, polishing everything – but we’re aiming to hit those dates!

As usual, I’m sharing a few SFW preview images since this post is public. Talk to you soon!

notes.title: Episode 4.1 - notes & release date
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

The time has finally come for the post you’ve all been waiting for – the release date of the next update!

I’m here to give you all the details, so you can mark your calendars and maybe even take some time off work. But first, let’s talk about the progress and what you can expect in the upcoming update.

Our artists are still struggling with renders and project work, so things are taking longer than I expected. I’m hopeful that everything will settle soon, and we’ll be able to speed things up. Right now, it’s the opposite—I’m spending my personal time overseeing their work and checking progress. But I see this as a normal adjustment phase, and with each scene, things should get easier.

In the next update, you can look forward to six new main scenes. We had to rearrange some things, so Richard won’t be in this one, but we’ll make up for it in update 4.2. Instead, you’ll meet the missing Wesley and his buddy Jay, Elijah and the nerds, plus the Dean with Madison. And who knows? Maybe a few more characters will show up too!

Besides the six main scenes, there will be two extra scenes—one involving VR and another hidden one. We’re also expanding some smaller storylines, like the bar job, adding new achievements, updating casual dialogues, and changing some few free roam renders.

Now, the info you’ve been waiting for—the release date for Episode 4.1 Steps of Debauchery:


March 23


To make the wait a little easier, here are some renders for you. See you soon!

Oh! And as always, don't forget to leave the review about the game - we have crossed 1,100 reviews and we are in the right direction to 1,200 reviews! Help the project and increase the number!

notes.title: #Episode 4.1 - Progress Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone on this peaceful Sunday!

I wanted to share some updates on our progress and what’s going on with us. So, as usual, let’s start with a quick overview:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/61f644be0946e4ec3dc0f9b7b96eba20b62ad6cb.png

As you can see, the scripts are now fully ready! That means the text part of Episode 4.1 is complete—we know exactly which scenes we’ll add, what content will be included, and all the extra details. We’re also past the halfway mark for the graphics—so far, we’ve created over four major scenes and a few additional elements. We’re slowly adding them to the game and testing everything to make sure it works. Soon, we’ll also start translating the scenes into all available game languages.

Progress is a bit slower than usual, but that’s because we’re working on multiple scenes at once, including some future ones. I won’t spoil anything now, but I promise you’ll love the surprise! On top of that, we’re still in the process of onboarding new artists, which hasn’t been going as smoothly as we hoped. Initially, we had four potential new artists, but one dropped out, and another didn’t meet our quality standards. That leaves us with two, and while we’re still trying to establish a long-term collaboration, we’ve run into quite a few challenges. Instead of speeding things up, it’s actually slowing us down, but I believe that in the long run, this investment will pay off.

Because of these setbacks, I can’t give you a specific release date for Episode 4.1 just yet. Some scenes are being handled by new artists, and I can’t be sure they’ll be finished on time or meet our quality expectations. If we need to redo or adjust them, it’ll take extra time. I value my word more than anything, so I’ll only announce a firm release date closer to March when I have more clarity.

But don’t worry! We’re taking a small step back now so we can jump forward and release content much faster in the future. My goal for 2025 remains the same—I’m aiming to release 12,000 new renders and tons of animations. We’ve already created over 1,500 this year, so once we get back on track, I hope to hit that target by October!

But enough talk—let’s get back to work! Here are a few renders for you to check out. 
Oh, and don't forget to leave a review, if you still did not - let's get 1100 reviews till end of the month! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2649970/Steps_of_Debauchery/

Have a great Sunday folks!

notes.title: Post-Release Thoughts and Plans
notes.notes:
A few days have passed since the release, so now with a clear head, it’s time for a quick recap of the last update of the year, plans for the coming weeks, and a look at what’s ahead for next year. Hi there!

Let’s start with the latest update. Overall, I’m pretty happy with it. From what I’ve read, most of you received it quite positively, except the usual complaints about "so short", "add my favorite path", "such a long wait for nothing". I’ve responded to these points after every update, but I’ll do it again here. Update 4.0 took me two months to make, working 14–16 hours a day, including weekends, and giving up social outings and personal enjoyments like the Stalker and PoE2 releases I’d been looking forward to (still haven’t played them). Comments like these make me a bit sad because I put so much of myself into this, but the reaction are always the same, no matter how hard I try. As for paths like Richard’s, not every path gets touched in every update - you’ll sometimes need to wait longer. So, if small updates aren’t your thing, it might be better to wait for 3–4 updates to drop or just hold out for the full release in 2026.

That said, I don’t want to sound bitter. I’m still happy with where we are now. Over the past 14 months since the game’s release, I think we’ve made huge progress. The renders are at a solid quality level, and the animations have significantly improved, so our focus now is on maintaining this standard.

The latest update also marks a turning point many of you were waiting for, but I also want to mention that there are not going to be a lot of branching paths - for example, the LI choice in the park quest had some importance but wasn’t crucial enough to warrant separate saves. You’ll see more in the next update. For now, we’re planning 4 main endings with some smaller variations.

Before moving on, I want to say thank you. When I launched the game in October 2023, I never imagined it would become my hobby, passion, and main source of income. This wouldn’t have been possible without your support. Thanks to you, I can create this game and not worry about tomorrow. Starting in January, I’ll be returning to my main job as a firefighter, but I’ll still dedicate all my free time to the game to keep updates coming every 2–3 months. And yes, they’ll be the same size as the current ones. I prefer to make smaller updates, but more often.

In three days, I’m taking my first proper break in a long time. I can’t remember a single day in the past 14 months when I wasn’t working on the game or at least thinking about what to add or improve. These two weeks should help me recharge so I can come back ready to continue Riley’s story.

As I mentioned, the full version of Steps of Debauchery is planned for 2026. We don’t want to stretch this project endlessly, and we already have a clear vision of what we want to deliver. The next update will likely come in March. Updates 4.1 and 4.2 will be smaller, as usual, focusing on side stories, slight progress in the main plot, and expanding additional features like jobs and free roam. We’ll also add some optional elements that we hope you’ll enjoy. I won’t spoil everything, though as that would ruin the fun! :)

Lot of reading, huh? So here’s the conclusion: Updates will stay small because we simply don’t have the resources (i.e., 3D artists) to create more scenes faster. Quality will always come before quantity. I’ve scheduled a few posts for you while I’m away so you don’t forget about me.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/12dbc40e17c6e9bd792be29c9e04e524b9697e35.png

Once again, thank you. Together, we’re building something truly special, and who knows what else we’ll create in the future. I wish you all a peaceful Christmas filled with time well-spent with your loved ones, and a great start to the new year. Go crush your goals and make all your plans happen.

Thanks, and see you soon!

Ps. There is a Christmas Sale on Steam and you can get both Steps of Debauchery and Bright Lord in nice discounts, even in a bundle! Once you get your version, don't forget to leave a review!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48735/Secret_Obsession/

notes.title: Episode 4.0 - progress update & release date
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

It's time to share our latest progress update. As usual, you’ll find the chart below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/4c1efddfa0fb5cf9451335f3db702aa7d356d863.png

As you can see, the scripts and written content for the game are now fully completed. For some time now, our writers have been working on future scenes to avoid unnecessary delays later on. The most time-consuming tasks remain rendering and animation, due to our current production capacity. We're actively looking for more skilled artists, but finding experienced professionals is a challenge. Lowering our quality standards is the last thing we want to do. We're also integrating the source code and testing everything so that only minor fixes will remain at the end.

We’re nearing the milestone of 2,000 renders, and we estimate the final count will be around 2,500–3,000. That’s a huge number, especially given how little time has passed since the last update. On top of that, this update will feature A LOT of animations. Besides the main scenes, we’re also planning to add a few extra features if time and resources allow.

Additionally, we’ve started working on translations for all the content currently in the game, so everything will be available simultaneously. On a side note, we’re happy to announce that a Polish translation will likely (95% certainty) be included as well, since many of you have requested it. We hope you’ll enjoy it!

Now for the most exciting news—the one you’ve probably been waiting for: Update 4.0 will launch on Monday, December 16th. Supporters in the +Lovers tier on Patreon will get early access on Friday, December 13th. That means we’re less than 30 days away from your holiday gift!

That’s all for now. We’re leaving you with a few renders and wish you a peaceful week ahead. 😊

notes.title: Bright Lord finally has a release date on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Now, I'd like to talk about something important to us—the second project we've been working on alongside Steps of Debauchery. First, let me assure you that Riley and Steps of Debauchery are still our main focus, and no other project will affect the development speed of the game. If we've chosen to support or join another project, it's only because we've been able to hire more people or work on it in parallel.

As some of you already know, the project I'm talking about is the game Bright Lord, developed by KissKiss Studio. It’s had its ups and downs, so we decided to help bring it to completion, ensuring it doesn’t get abandoned like so many other adult visual novels. Our support included proofreading the entire script, improving and compressing the game’s code, creating a completely new UX/UI, and translating the game into 7 languages. The story and graphics are still being handled by KissKiss Studio, so this hasn’t affected our work on Steps of Debauchery.

You’ll be able to see the results of our work soon, as Bright Lord will be released on Steam on November 8th, with all the new features we've added. I encourage you to add it to your wishlist now!

I decided to support this project because I liked the game and its story, and I’m confident you’ll enjoy it too. This version will include about 75% of the full game, and the final release is planned for 2025. We’re aiming to add six more chapters before the game’s conclusion. Here are a few renders from the game, and we’ll see you in less than a month!

notes.title: Episode 3.2 - notes & release date
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

As some of you from Discord might know, I haven’t been able to work for the last 10 days because of a flood that hit my country. Luckily, I didn’t suffer any major damage—just a few things to replace, lots of cleaning and drying out, but thankfully, my family is safe. Today we’re finally getting back to normal, with electricity and water restored (though it’s only cold water for now, but it’s progress!). We've cleaned up the rest, so I can finally start focusing on the game again. I also want to thank you all for your support—it really helped me stay calm and handle everything, so thank you!

As for the update, unfortunately, I have to delay it a bit for the first time— instead of the end of the month, we’ll release it at the start of October. New update will be released:

Steps of Debauchery - Episode 3.2 - 7th October 

Aside from that, everything is going according to plan. Even though it’s a small update, I think it’ll still be worth checking out. We've also improved some models and graphics, but you’ll only notice that in the next 4.0 episode. The delay won’t affect the 4.0 update, which is still set to release in December—and trust me, it’ll be worth it.

I’ve been wondering why it now takes me 1.5-2 months to make a small update, when I used to be able to do it in just one month. The answer is pretty simple – translations take a lot of time, and the animations are much more time-consuming (but they also look way better) compared to the early days. We still keep the same number of quests in each small update, around 7, but before, the scenes were much smaller – each had 70-100 renders, and now each scene has over 100, with some having more than 200.

Not that it really matters, just a thought I had.

That’s all for now! The change log will be out closer to the release. As usual, I’m leaving a few teasers for you, this time SFW (mostly)!

notes.title: Episode 3.1 - News and Release Date
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

It's been a while since I shared any updates, so it's time for some news. I've mentioned many of these things on Discord and social media, but I'll recap everything here.

First, on a personal note, I've decided to take unpaid leave until the end of the year to focus on the game project and to get some rest and attend to my personal life. Thanks to your support (both through game purchases and monthly donations), I can start considering leaving my second job at the Fire Department and working less. I'm incredibly grateful to all of you for this, but it doesn't mean I'll be slacking off. This break will allow me to rest a bit and spend more time with my family and most importantly, focus on game creation.

As for the new update - Episode 3.1 is almost ready, with just the animations left to finish. I hope everything goes smoothly so we can complete them within a week. This update is half the size of update 3.0, but it only took us just over a month to complete, which I think is great. What can you expect in this update? I'll share the details in the change log next week.

We plan to release the new update on August 10th, which is about a week away.

Reminder: This is a small update. If you don't like smaller updates, feel free to skip this one and wait for the next release

I hope there won't be any delays due to the animations, but we should be able to meet the deadline. After the update, I'll need about three weeks to handle some work-related tasks before fully starting my leave until the end of the year. 

That's all for now. Here are a few renders for you. Episode 3.1 is just about a week away!

notes.title: Episode 3.1 - Update Summary, Game Development and Notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I have a lot to share with you today, but let's start with a summary of the latest update and some of my notes. I've already shared these on Discord, but I'll summarize them here too.

The days after releasing a new update are always the toughest for me mentally. I spend them combing through every forum reading players feedback. This includes everything from trolls and long-time critics to supportive fans. I’m also on the lookout for bugs reported by players so we can fix them promptly. 

Bugs and Issues 
We've fixed all the reported bugs. One critical bug related to the iSpy app was preventing further progress in some cases. There were also minor issues with minigames, Discord on Mac, and a missing scene in the replay gallery. These have all been fixed. We've also made the dance minigame a bit easier and we’re ready to fix any new bugs immediately.

Feedback on Update Length 
I've addressed this many times, but here’s my previous information about the developing job (I wrote it some time ago, so that's copy-paste):
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/b3cddb803b21ad4f3b28adf359e9870d664d1b34.jpg
...my job as a firefighter sometimes allows me extra time off, which I dedicate to game development. Over the past three months (aside from my vacation), I’ve been working 12-16 hours daily to create what we’ve released. Despite this, some still find the update “short.” I might need to slow down and give myself more mental freedom because no matter how hard I work, people will always complain about the update being too short. (edit. we are actively looking for additional Daz3D artists, but we rather want to improve the quality of the renders, so finding the right person(s) is very hard and we have not succeeded so far).

Content and Story Feedback 
I agree that we could have added more sexual content to the yacht scene, but I didn't think it was appropriate and really needed. We don't want to add empty sex scenes just for the sake of it. This update was not shallow in my opinion, as it containted three other sex scenes. I'm sure we'll soon get to the point where everyone will see what they're waiting for, but scenes in which sexual acts don't occur also affect the main character's mental attitude. You may disagree with this, but it does not change my approach to the storyline we are creating.

It’s important to remember that an Adult Visual Novel combines both - "Adult" content, but also "Novel" aspect. If someone is here only for the adult content and ignores the novel aspect, they might be disappointed—that’s not our aim (yes, I'm aware we are creating porn game :wink:)

Regarding complaints about the D&D, Elijah or any other plotlines: it's impossible to please everyone. Some enjoy these storylines, others don’t. Making them optional would undermine the main narrative. Every plot point, including D&D, has an impact on the main character, if not now, then in future updates. We don't add random storylines; everything has a purpose. We also can't feature every character in every update. Episode 2.2 focused on Elijah and Richard; 3.0 focused on other things; episode 3.1 will be about something else. We’re doing our best to release content quickly and on time. If you found this update small, you might want to wait for 4.0 and skip previous two small updates till then.

Lastly, regarding the bar minigame: it’s optional and doesn’t affect the main story, but we already made it easier for everyone. It will have its development in episode 3.1 but will remain non-essential to the main plot.

That would be it. I take every feedback to heart, we have our idea for the game, but we also take your opinion into consideration. However, we will not add a sex scene with Riley, just because we feel such pressure on our backs. I am always available to you and I write back to every message, however, if you need help with the game or you have encountered an error - share it on discord so that it is easier to solve them. If you would like to add something, feel free to comment and share your thoughts.

That will be it about Episode 3.0, so let's move to development of Episode 3.1 and some notes!

Progress on Episode 3.1 is going smoothly. As you can see in the image below, our scripts and writing are almost done. We've also completed about 40% of the graphics and renders, and started adding new scenes and content directly to the game. We're planning to add six main scenes, one extra scene, and more activities related to the park, school, and the bar minigame.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/fd5920b99469e400dc9e55816029483f59e96015.png

Episode 3.1 will be a small update. We're sticking to our plan of releasing two small updates (x.1 and x.2) followed by a bigger one (0.x). If you don't like small updates, please wait for the next one or even Episode 4.0. Respect our work and refrain from comments like "too short." We're doing our best to release updates regularly and spend all our free time creating the game. The new update will be out in mid-August.

(Who would I be if I didn't share a few new renders?)

Take care and see you soon!

notes.title: #Episode 3.0 - Current Progress & Release Date
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

The day you've all been waiting for is finally here (well, not the release day, but close) - today I'll give you an update on our progress, idea of what you can expect in the new update, and when it's coming out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/b0391a1ae1bba99a5ed2b6e4c28fb9de600652d5.png

Let's start from the beginning - the writing for Episode 3.0 is done, all scripts are ready, and the writer has already started on Update 3.1. We use his creativity as much as we can, and he keeps delivering great stuff. Creating scenes and renders takes the most time - I spent a lot of time looking for the right people to help, but no luck so far. I hope we'll hire someone soon to speed up future updates. Coding and testing come last - we're slowly adding new things but will focus on this in early June.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/ca66fdc41e4edc66304edd184eb7962c7d57c3a9.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/0168a92336a5c108d0c740937e64ad66689c7fd8.png

Now, a bit about the plot in episode 3.0 - Riley will begin her journey as Dean Scott's assistant (unless you opted out of that storyline). We'll discover Blaze's hidden hobby, which might become ours too. It's also time to thank Madison for her help during the bachelor party. There will be two D&D scenes (I know not everyone likes this, but I think you'll enjoy these). Our secret donor on Spy App will get in touch again. There will also be a bar scene and the biggest scene we've made so far, which will be a surprise. Plus, we're adding a gym scene and a new mini-game job at the bar. You'll also be able to buy new stuff for your apartment and test it in a bonus scene. We're aiming to add Italian and Polish translations too. Our animations are now much better, and I'm sure you'll love them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/fc7c401cbfb7afab9be3d52e8f68c92c206e1ebc.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/1e27cbddf9ce4ee29af59997bf9eb3db1a179897.png

This update will be almost twice the size of 2.2 - I hope we can hire new DAZ3D artists to make updates faster. And now, the news you've been waiting for - the official release date for Episode 3.0 is June 25th. I'll try my best to let the highest tiers play a few days earlier, but no promises. As I said, no breaks for us, we're starting on Episode 3.1 right after this update, aiming for an early August release.

That's all for now, I hope you will enjoy new update. Back to work for me, have a great week!

PS. There's also a new trailer for Steps of Debauchery. You can check it out on Store Page!

notes.title: After Release Reflections
notes.notes:
Hi there!

It's been exactly a week since the game was released on Steam, so it's time for a little summary. The game has attracted a lot of interest, beyond our expectations, which delights us immensely and gives us the momentum to create new updates and scenes. Thank you!

We've received various opinions and private messages - some opinions were certainly helpful as they provided additional perspectives on the entire project, while others were strictly about the content itself or other games. First and foremost, I'd like to mention that a year ago, I knew nothing about being a developer or releasing games; my focus was mainly on creating renders. I've learned a lot during this time, but I realize there's still much to learn, and even more to improve. However, believe me, I'm learning quickly, and I'll quickly catch up - and as Bill Brooks wrote, you don't need super knowledge, just surround yourself with the right people.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/0df6704aad252ca920cefcf9ff2a577651d5b898.png

Regarding the content and its quantity - as I've mentioned several times before, a game based on the corruption of the main character needs to be a bit of a slow burn to show their transformation. If it happens too quickly, the whole story wouldn't make sense. We're roughly at 25-30% completion of the entire project, so there are still many scenes ahead of you (and us).

However, comparing our project to others like "Innocence and Money," "Being a DIK," etc., and giving negative ratings based on them is somewhat unfair from one simple standpoint - they've been in development for years and often by experienced developers, whereas our project is still in its infancy and only growing, so please give it time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/5b49d68ff9bea78dc6e5c8fe83f7df86bb6fb79f.png

That's it for now; I hope you all enjoyed it nonetheless, and thank you for your trust. We won't let you down! As you could read in Early Access, the entire project is planned for 7-8 episodes (more likely 7, but we'll see if we want to add additional side plots and expand the world more than planned), with each episode having two smaller chapters. Below, I present you with the update schedule:

Episode 1.0 -> 1.1 -> 1.2 

Episode 2.0 -> 2.1 -> 2.2  (we are here and working on update 2.2)

Episode 3.0 -> 3.1 -> 3.2 

Episode 4.0 -> 4.1 -> 4.2 

Episode 5.0 -> 5.1 -> 5.2 

Episode 6.0 -> 6.1 -> 6.2 

Episode 7

We plan to release larger full episodes (2.0, 3.0, etc.) every approximately 8-10 weeks (9-11 scenes), followed by two smaller ones (2.1, 2.2, etc.) every approximately 5-7 weeks (5-7 scenes). I believe it's better to release smaller updates in shorter intervals than, like most developers, a big update every six months or more. We truly value quality, and each of us works in every spare moment to achieve the goal.

That's all from me for now; I wanted you to know what our plans are and how everything looks from my perspective. I'm getting back to work because, as you know, the new update is coming in a month - March 14th!

notes.title: Steam version - Episode 2.1
notes.notes:
Hey there! 

Just under three days left until the game is released on Steam, less than 72 hours! It's been a cool journey to this point over the past year and a half (the beginnings were different, and mostly difficult, but the first and preliminary renders for the game were made in the second half of 2022). A lot of time has been spent creating, preparing, refining, but it's been a truly interesting time, and it's finally coming together. This is a very important moment for me, but it's not the end of our journey; I would say it's the real beginning!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/13415e434ab3095357b24440e9c5f81ba318553d.png

You could have played the game already through support on my patreon, but then what can you expect from this version? First and foremost, seven new languages - Simplified Chinese, Spanish (Latam), Portuguese-Brazil, Russian, French, German, Hungarian. We have a slight delay with Traditional Chinese, but it will also be in the game by mid-February. We'll soon start working on Polish, Turkish, and Italian as well. All previous errors will also be fixed.

I encourage you to buy and leave reviews - it's crucial for us, as more reviews significantly boost the game's visibility and also helps us improve the game - whether it's positive or negative feedback!

That's it; we have a busy weekend ahead to wrap everything up, but we're almost there!

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
Hello folks!

This is Fooxied, the developer behind Steps of Debauchery. As you've probably noticed on the main page, the game's sales and access will start on February 5th. We're extremely excited because we can't wait to hear your feedback on the game - what you liked and enjoyed, but also aspects we can improve in the future.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/2f26e0d50e948bc2df7931431cf4c9d775b6002b.png

As you may have read in the Early Access section, we plan to release the full game by the end of 2026 and expand the current content at least sixfold (and we still have about 5 hours of content right now). We aim to release new updates every 1-2 months, depending on their content. We lean towards smaller updates so that you can check out what's new from time to time, rather than having large updates every six months.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44779210/f24e91ac40a06780916c6d6b96cc46e98cab5b26.png

I also invite you to join our Discord, where I'm happy to answer all your questions, whether they're about the game itself or what I had for breakfast. I dedicate a lot of time to people who enjoy our project, and I believe that sets it apart from others. While I know what I want to create, I'm always open to considering your insights.

I'm getting back to creating new content, and I look forward to seeing you on February 5th.
